title: Update two live evaluation witnesses for the producer's evaluation record field
outcome: The independent-refresh and sub-agent live witnesses read the current producer evaluation record id and verify the intended canonical evaluation, without depending on the removed hash alias.
acceptance: The two affected witnesses use the producer's documented evaluation record identity and still inspect the canonical recorded evaluation and distinct whole attempts/sub-agent identity as originally intended.

A pinned disposable Engram check passes both witnesses against a build containing alias-removal commit 6b4a3a6b10e5e120eb9f41be3ce4cc5ac912af03, retaining original failure evidence; no compatibility fallback to an obsolete hash alias is added.
Independent review and the required exact-input gate pass before landing.
